verdict.rationale: Twenty documents exporting workspace data at any time for backups or migration, with an explicit 'no lock-in' claim. Self-hosting lets you own your data end to end, and REST/GraphQL APIs expose every object, including custom ones, for programmatic extraction. However, exports are capped at 20,000 records each, and the evidence never names the export file format. missing for 10: explicit documentation of open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), a full-workspace export without the 20k-record cap, independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete exit/migration.
